intro: Really dozens of regional cuisines: rich creamy curries and tandoor breads in the north, rice, coconut and dosas in the south, all built on layered spices.
flavours: Cumin, coriander, turmeric, garam masala, ghee, chilli, curry leaves
hk: Chungking Mansions in Tsim Sha Tsui is Hong Kong's legendary spot for cheap, authentic South Asian food.

dishes.name: Butter chicken
dishes.what: Tandoori chicken in a mild, creamy tomato-butter sauce, invented in Delhi.

dishes.name: Biryani
dishes.what: Fragrant layered rice and meat cooked together with saffron and fried onions; Hyderabad and Lucknow are famous.

dishes.name: Tandoori chicken
dishes.what: Chicken marinated in yoghurt and spices, roasted in a clay tandoor oven until charred red.

dishes.name: Masala dosa
dishes.what: South Indian crisp, paper-thin fermented rice crêpe wrapped around spiced potato, with sambar and chutney.

dishes.name: Palak paneer
dishes.what: Cubes of fresh cheese in a spiced spinach purée.

dishes.name: Rogan josh
dishes.what: Kashmiri lamb curry, deep red from mild Kashmiri chilli.

dishes.name: Chole bhature
dishes.what: Spicy chickpea curry with huge puffed fried breads; a Punjabi favourite.

dishes.name: Samosa
dishes.what: Triangular fried pastry stuffed with spiced potato and peas.

dishes.name: Pani puri
dishes.what: Crisp hollow puri filled with spicy tamarind water, eaten in one bite; also called golgappa.

dishes.name: Naan
dishes.what: Soft, leavened flatbread slapped onto the wall of a tandoor; garlic naan is a favourite.

dishes.name: Gulab jamun
dishes.what: Soft fried milk dumplings soaking in rose-cardamom syrup.
